plugin.name: Mechanical Keyboard
plugin.description: Simulate authentic tactile and clicky mechanical keyboard typing sounds with bar toggle and sound packs.

bar.tooltip-on:
Mechanical Keyboard: Active ({pack})
• Left-click: Open Settings
• Right-click: Mute / Unmute
• Scroll: Adjust Volume
bar.tooltip-off:
Mechanical Keyboard: Muted
• Left-click: Open Settings
• Right-click: Unmute

enabled.label: Enable Mechanical Typing Sounds
enabled.desc: Play authentic mechanical switch sound feedback whenever typing

soundPack.label: Switch Sound Profile
soundPack.desc: Choose your preferred mechanical keyboard switch type

volume.label: Sound Volume
volume.desc: Adjust playback loudness of typing sound effects

inputDevice.label: Keyboard Device
inputDevice.desc: Select specific keyboard hardware or auto-listen to all keyboards

enableToasts.label: Notification Toasts
enableToasts.desc: Display feedback toast notifications when toggling sound or switching profiles
